title: Moon Recession Ends Total Eclipses In 600 Million Years
hook: The Moon is slowly shrinking out of total eclipses.
closing: Total eclipses are temporary, and we live while the Moon still appears large enough.
question: Would you travel for a total eclipse?

segments.say: The Moon has receded 2.17 meters, a steady shift we can measure.
The Moon is now 384,400 kilometers away, so its apparent size keeps shrinking.
In 600 million years, the Moon will look too small for total eclipses.
